questions.question: Two trains are running in opposite directions. They cross a man standing on a platform in 28 seconds and 10 seconds. respectively. They cross each other in 24 seconds. What is the ratio of their speeds?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the **Alligation Method** using the time taken by each train to cross the man and the common time to cross each other.

Time for Train 1 (t₁) = 28 s | Time for Train 2 (t₂) = 10 s | Mean Time (tₘ) = 24 s

Ratio of speeds = (tₘ − t₂) : (t₁ − tₘ)

Ratio of speeds = (24 − 10) : (28 − 24) = 14 : 4 = 7 : 2

**∴ The correct answer is 7 : 2.**

questions.question: The mean proportion between a number and 20 is 50. What is that number?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For any two numbers **a** and **b**, the **Mean Proportion (M)** is given by M = √(a × b).

To find the missing number, use the squared relation: b = M² ÷ a.

Given M = 50 and a = 20.

⇒ Required Number = 50² ÷ 20 = 2500 ÷ 20 = 125.

**∴ The correct answer is 125.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mean proportional value = 50

One of the numbers = 20

**Formula Used:**

If **x** is the mean proportion between **a** and **b**, then **a : x = x : b**, which implies **x² = ab**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4b1949053fbf69969dd761daca8f1839594e6440a907bc616e846d55e1f4cc8.png] 

Let the required number be **n**.

⇒ √(20 × n) = 50

Squaring both sides:

⇒ 20 × n = 50 × 50

⇒ 20 × n = 2500

⇒ n = 2500 ÷ 20

⇒ n = 125

**∴ The correct answer is 125.**

**__Additional Information__**

Third Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a:b = b:c), then **c** is the third proportional to a and b, calculated as **c = b²/a**.

Fourth Proportional

If four numbers a, b, c, and d are in proportion (a:b = c:d), then **d** is the fourth proportional, calculated as **d = (b × c) / a**.

Mean Proportional Property

The mean proportional between two numbers is always the **positive square root** of their product, also known as the **Geometric Mean**.</p

questions.question: 15% of an alloy was silver. If in a quantity of alloy there was 51 g of silver, what was the quantity of the other elements in the alloy?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Silver** = 15% = 51 g

**Other elements** = 100% − 15% = 85%

Direct calculation: (51 ÷ 15) × 85

3.4 × 85 = 289 g

**∴ The correct answer is 289 g.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of **silver** in **alloy** = 15%

Weight of **silver** = 51 g

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9f1537bb3316d9c67f7aa5d26099c0164d2df747c20ae3137f9f69a58bfa5d4.png] 

**Formula:**

Weight of other elements = (Weight of silver ÷ Silver percentage) × Percentage of other elements

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total weight of the **alloy** be 'x' g.

⇒ 15% of x = 51

⇒ (15 ÷ 100) × x = 51

⇒ x = (51 × 100) ÷ 15

⇒ x = 340 g (Total weight of **alloy**)

⇒ Weight of **other elements** = Total weight − Silver weight

⇒ Weight of **other elements** = 340 − 51

⇒ Weight of **other elements** = 289 g

**∴ The correct answer is 289 g.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage of Components

The sum of the percentages of all components in a mixture or **alloy** is always 100%.

Ratio Method for Mixtures

If an **alloy** contains 15% **silver**, the ratio of **silver** to **other elements** is 15 : 85, which simplifies to 3 : 17.

Total Quantity Formula

Total quantity = (Value of part ÷ Percentage of part) × 100. For **alloy**, 340 = (51 ÷ 15) × 100.</p

questions.question: A batsman has a certain average of runs for 58 innings. In the 59th inning he scores 117 runs there by increasing his average 1.5 runs. What will be his average after 59th innings.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

New Average = Score in **last inning** − (**Previous innings** × Increase in average)

New Average = 117 − (58 × 1.5)

New Average = 117 − 87 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total innings = **59** | Previous innings = **58**

Runs in 59th inning = **117** | Increase in average = **1.5**

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total Runs ÷ Number of Innings

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74aef71c77b83827ae45789cec1ce09ecb9862796fe652d618faa94516c04e99.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the average after 58 innings be **x**.

⇒ Total runs after 58 innings = **58 × x**

⇒ New total runs after 59 innings = **58x + 117**

⇒ New average = (58x + 117) ÷ 59 = **x + 1.5**

⇒ 58x + 117 = 59(x + 1.5)

⇒ 58x + 117 = 59x + 88.5

⇒ 59x − 58x = 117 − 88.5

⇒ x = **28.5** (Old Average)

⇒ New Average after 59th inning = 28.5 + 1.5 = **30**

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Concept of New Average

When a new observation is added, New Average = Old Average + (Change in total ÷ New number of observations).

Total Run Increase

The total increase in runs across all innings is calculated as: Increase = New Innings × Increase in average (59 × 1.5 = 88.5).

Net Deviation

Score of new inning = Old Average + (New total count × Average Increase).</p

questions.question: The cost price of two dozen bananas is Rs. 30. After selling 15 bananas at the rate of Rs. 12 per dozen, the shopkeeper sells the remaining bananas at the rate of Rs. 5 per dozen. What is the loss percentage?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total bananas = 2 dozen = 24. **Cost Price (CP)** = ₹30.

**Selling Price (SP)** for 15 bananas = 15 × (₹12 ÷ 12) = ₹15.

Remaining 9 bananas **SP** = 9 × (₹5 ÷ 12) = ₹3.75.

Total **SP** = 15 + 3.75 = ₹18.75.

**Loss %** = [(30 − 18.75) ÷ 30] × 100 = (11.25 ÷ 30) × 100 = 37.5%.

**∴ The correct answer is 37.5%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total quantity = 24 **bananas** (2 dozen)

**Total CP** = ₹30

**Rate 1** = ₹12 per dozen | **Quantity 1** = 15 bananas

**Rate 2** = ₹5 per dozen | **Quantity 2** = 9 bananas (24 − 15)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba822465d5f488a405ae58827c9e07cd41c19604b68e7d9c56d59a685559580c.png] 

**Formula Used:**

**Loss** = **Cost Price (CP)** − **Selling Price (SP)**

**Loss Percentage** = (**Loss** ÷ **CP**) × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ **SP** of 15 bananas = 15 × (12 ÷ 12) = ₹15

⇒ **SP** of remaining 9 bananas = 9 × (5 ÷ 12) = 45 ÷ 12 = ₹3.75

⇒ **Total SP** = 15 + 3.75 = ₹18.75

⇒ **Total Loss** = 30 − 18.75 = ₹11.25

⇒ **Loss %** = (11.25 ÷ 30) × 100

⇒ **Loss %** = 0.375 × 100 = 37.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 37.5%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Profit Percentage Formula

When **SP** > **CP**, Profit % = [(**SP** − **CP**) ÷ **CP**] × 100.

Selling Price Calculation

In case of **Loss**, **SP** = **CP** × (100 − **Loss %**) ÷ 100. In case of **Profit**, **SP** = **CP** × (100 + **Profit %**) ÷ 100.

Unit Conversion

1 **Dozen** = 12 units. Always convert rates to a single unit (per item) or convert quantities to dozens for calculation consistency.

questions.question: The difference between the compound and the simple interests for 3 years at the rate of 20% per annum is ₹432. What is the principal lent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The difference between the Compound (CI) and the Simple interests (SI) is ₹432.

Time (T) = 3 years 

The Rate (R) of interest = 20% per annum

**Concept used:**

Compound Interest = P(1 + R%)T 

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

CI - SI = Rs. 432

⇒ 432 = [P(1 + 20%)3 - 1] - [(P × 20 × 3)/100]

⇒ 432 = P[(1 + 20%)3 - 1] - P[(20 × 3)/100]

⇒ 432 = P[(1 + 0.20)3] - P[6/10]

⇒ 432 = P[(1.20)3 - 1] - P[3/5]

⇒ 432 = P[1.728 - 1 - 3/5]

⇒ 432 = P[(3.64 - 3)/5]

⇒ 432 = P[0.64/5]

⇒ P = 432/0.128

⇒ P = Rs. 3375

**∴ The principal lent was Rs. 3375.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**20% = 20/100 = 1/5

questions.question: A person travels from A to B at a speed of 30 km/h and returns at a speed of 45 km/h. What is the average speed in km/h during the whole journey?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the **distance** traveled is the **same** for both speeds, apply the harmonic mean formula.

Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

Average Speed = (2 × 30 × 45) ÷ (30 + 45) = 2700 ÷ 75 = 36 kmph.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3abf91e0e45aa5f34ae5e42162b5c2d3d432eece71fba89bdcf694100fad70e1.png] 

**Given:**

Speed from A to B (S₁) = 30 km/h

Speed from B to A (S₂) = 45 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the distance between A and B be the **LCM** of 30 and 45 = 90 km.

⇒ Time taken from A to B (T₁) = 90 ÷ 30 = 3 hours.

⇒ Time taken from B to A (T₂) = 90 ÷ 45 = 2 hours.

⇒ Total Distance = 90 + 90 = 180 km.

⇒ Total Time = 3 + 2 = 5 hours.

⇒ Average Speed = 180 ÷ 5 = 36 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Time

If a person travels at different speeds for **equal time intervals**, the average speed is the **Arithmetic Mean**: (S₁ + S₂) ÷ 2.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in **opposite directions**, relative speed = S₁ + S₂. In the **same direction**, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.</p

The average monthly expenditure of a family was Rs. 4,000/- for the first three months; Rs. 4,500/- for the next 4 months and Rs. 5,000/- for the last 5 months of a year. If the total saving during the year was Rs. 5,000, find the average monthly income of the family
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average monthly expenditure for the first 3 months = Rs. 4,000

Average monthly expenditure for the next 4 months = Rs. 4,500

Average monthly expenditure for the next 5 months = Rs. 5,000

Total saving during the year = Rs. 5,000

**Formula Used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Average = (Sum of the terms)/(Number of the terms)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Average monthly expenditure for the first 3 months = Rs. 4,000

Total expenditure for the first 3 months = 4,000 × 3 = Rs. 12,000

Average monthly expenditure for the next 4 months = Rs. 4,500

Total expenditure for the next 4 months = 4,500 × 4 = Rs. 18,000

Average monthly expenditure for the next 5 months = Rs. 5,000

Total expenditure for the next 5 months = 5,000 × 5 = Rs. 25,000

Total expenditure during the year = 12,000 + 18,000 + 25,000

**⇒** 55,000

Given, total saving during the year = Rs. 5,000

We know that, Income = Expenditure + Savings

Income during the year = 55,000 + 5,000 = Rs. 60,000

Average monthly income = Income during the year/Number of months in a year

Average monthly income = (60,000)/(12) = Rs. 5,000

**∴ The average monthly income of the family is Rs. 5,000.**

questions.question: A hospital room is to accommodate 56 patients. It should be done in such a way that every patient gets 2.2 m² of floor and 8.8 m³ of space. If the length of the room is 14 m, the breadth and the height of the room are respectively
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total Floor Area = 56 × 2.2 m²

Breadth = Total Area ÷ Length = (56 × 2.2) ÷ 14 = 4 × 2.2 = 8.8 m

Height = Space per patient ÷ Floor area per patient = 8.8 ÷ 2.2 = 4 m

**∴ The correct answer is 8.8 m, 4 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of patients = 56

Floor area per patient = 2.2 m²

Space (Volume) per patient = 8.8 m³

Length (L) of the room = 14 m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a920fc0c02bc1724edf8a02d4d11e1d431bd06a773ef09e37f09867ac0b962.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Floor Area = 56 × 2.2 = 123.2 m²

⇒ We know, Floor Area = Length × Breadth

⇒ 123.2 = 14 × Breadth

⇒ Breadth = 123.2 ÷ 14 = 8.8 m

⇒ Total Volume = 56 × 8.8 = 492.8 m³

⇒ We know, Volume = Length × Breadth × Height

⇒ 492.8 = 14 × 8.8 × Height

⇒ 492.8 = 123.2 × Height

⇒ Height = 492.8 ÷ 123.2 = 4 m

**∴ The correct answer is 8.8 m, 4 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The volume of a rectangular room or cuboid is given by the formula V = Length × Breadth × Height.

Relationship between Volume and Area

The volume can also be expressed as Volume = Base Area × Height, where Base Area = Length × Breadth.

Total Surface Area

The total surface area of a cuboid is 2 × (LB + BH + LH), while the area of four walls is 2H × (L + B).</p

questions.question: A and B alone can do a piece of work in 7 days and 14 days respectively. In how many days the work will be completed if they both work on alternate days starting with A?
questions.solution:
**Given data:** 

A can do the work in 7 days,

B can do the work in 14 days.

**Concept Used:**

Total Work = LCM of total number of days

Efficiecny = Total Work/Total number day 

**Solution:**

The LCM of 7 and 14, is 14 = the total work.

⇒ Calculate A's work per day: 14/7 = 2 units/day.

⇒ Calculate B's work per day: 14/14 = 1 unit/day.

Work done by A and B in two days:

⇒ 2 units (by A on the first day) + 1 unit (by B on the second day) = 3 units.

Determine the amount of work done in 8 days,

⇒ 4 sets of 2-day intervals: 4 × 3 = 12 units.

On the 9th day,

⇒ A will work and complete the remaining 2 units of work.

**Therefore, the work will be completed in 9 days when they both work on alternate days starting with A.**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to ₹ 7485 after 3 years and to ₹ 9960 after 8 years at the same rate per cent per annum at simple interest. On simple interest, what will be the amount (in ₹) of the same sum after 7 years at double the earlier rate of interest?
questions.solution:
Given:

An amount to ₹ 7485 after 3 years at SI

The same amount to ₹ 9960 after 8 years at SI

In both cases, rate of interest is same. 

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

Where, P = Principal amount; R = Rate of interest per year;

T = Time 9in years)

Calculation:

Interest in (8 - 3) i.e. 5 years = 9960 - 7485 = ₹ 2475

Interest per year = 2475/5 = ₹495

Let, the principal amount and the rate of interest be ₹ P and R% respectively.

According to the question,

(P × 1 × R)/100 = 495

⇒ PR/100 = 495 ---(1)

According to the question,

P + (P × 3 × R)/100 = 7485

⇒ P + 3PR/100 = 7485 ---(2)

P + (P × 8 × R)/100 = 9960

⇒ P +8PR/100 = 9960 ---(3)

Now, (2) + (3),

⇒ (P + 3PR/100) + (P +8PR/100) = 7485 + 9960

⇒ 2P + 11PR/100 = 17445 ---(4)

Substituting equation (1) in equation (4),

⇒ 2P + (11 × 495) = 17445

⇒ 2P = 17445 - (11 × 495)

⇒ 2P = 12000

⇒ P = 6000

Putting P = 6000 in equation (1),

(6,000 × R)/100 = 495

⇒ R = 495/60 = 8.25

So, the revised simple interest rate = 8.25 × 2 = 16.5%

Now, the amount in 7 years

⇒ 6000 + (6000 × 16.5 × 7)/100

⇒ ₹12930

**∴ The amount becomes ₹12930.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**⇒ Amount for 8 yr = 9960 --- (eq 1)

⇒ Amountthe for 3 yr = 7485 --- (eq 2)

Subtracting (eq 1) and (eq 2) we get

⇒ SI for 5 year = 2475

⇒ SI for 1 year = 495

⇒ SI for 3 year = 1485

We know that Amount = SI + P (for 3 yr)

As per question amount for 3 yr = 7485

⇒ 7485 = 1485 + P

⇒ P = 6000

Using SI formula for 1 year

⇒ Rate% = (495 × 100)/6000 = 8.25%

⇒ 2 × Rate% = 16.5%

Amount for 7 years = SI + P (for 7 yr)

⇒ Amount = [(6000 × 16.5 × 7)/100] + 6000

⇒ Amount = 12930

**∴ The correct answer is Option 1).**

questions.question: If x is inversely proportional to y, and y = 6 when x = 7, find the value of x, when y = 64.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

questions.question: X takes 5 days more than Y and 9 days more than Z to finish a piece of work. X and Y can do a piece of work together in the same time in which the Z alone can do the work. In how many days X finishes the work?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

X takes 5 days more than Y and 9 days more than Z to finish a piece of work.

X and Y can do a piece of work together in the same time in which the Z alone can do the work.

**Calculation:**

The time taken by X to complete the piece of work = t days

The efficiency of X = (1)/(t)

The time taken by Y to complete the piece of work = (t - 5) days

The efficiency of Y = (1)/(t-5)

The time taken by Z to complete the piece of work = (t - 9) days

The efficiency of Z = (1)/(t-9)

Since X and Y can do a piece of work together in the same time in which the Z alone can do the work.

Therefore, the efficiency of X and Y together and Z alone are same.

So,

Rightarrow (1)/(t) + (1)/(t-5) = (1)/(t-9)

Now, by using options for the value of t as 15 days.

Rightarrow (1)/(15) + (1)/(15-5) = (1)/(15-9) \ Rightarrow (1)/(15) + (1)/(10) = (1)/(6)\ Rightarrow (1)/(6) = (1)/(6)\\

It can be inferred that,

The time taken by X to complete the piece of work = 15 days

**∴ The time taken by X to complete the piece of work is 15 days.**

questions.question: Train A running at 81 km/h takes 72 sec to overtake train B, when both the trains are running in the same direction, but it takes 36 sec to cross each other if the trains are running in the opposite direction. If the length of train B is 600 metres, then find the length of train A. (in metres)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Time taken** (Same direction : Opposite direction) = 72 : 36 = 2 : 1.

Ratio of **Relative Speed** (Same : Opposite) = 1 : 2 (since Distance is same).

Let speeds be VA and VB. ⇒ (VA − VB) / (VA + VB) = 1 / 2.

By Componendo and Dividendo, VA / VB = (2+1) / (2−1) = 3 / 1.

Given VA = 81 km/h ⇒ VB = 27 km/h. Total Distance (LA + LB) = Relative speed (Opposite) × Time = (81 + 27) × (5/18) × 36 = 1080 m.

LA = 1080 − 600 = 480 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 480 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/783bb2f6a08a59b0c2e0ce42af1e5088c28ec7461e131809d88fb61f7c53c3f9.png] 

**Given:** Speed of Train A (VA) = 81 km/h, Length of Train B (LB) = 600 m.

**Formula:** Distance = Relative Speed × Time; 1 km/h = 5/18 m/s.

⇒ Let LA be length of Train A and VB be speed of Train B.

⇒ Case 1 (Same direction): LA + 600 = (81 − VB) × (5/18) × 72

⇒ LA + 600 = (81 − VB) × 20 ... (i)

⇒ Case 2 (Opposite direction): LA + 600 = (81 + VB) × (5/18) × 36

⇒ LA + 600 = (81 + VB) × 10 ... (ii)

⇒ Equating (i) and (ii): (81 − VB) × 20 = (81 + VB) × 10

⇒ 162 − 2VB = 81 + VB ⇒ 3VB = 81 ⇒ VB = 27 km/h

⇒ LA + 600 = (81 + 27) × 10 = 1080

⇒ LA = 1080 − 600 = 480 m

**∴ The correct answer is 480 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the **same direction**, relative speed is |V₁ − V₂|. When moving in the **opposite direction**, it is V₁ + V₂.

Crossing Distance

To fully cross or overtake each other, two trains must cover a distance equal to the **sum of their lengths** (L₁ + L₂).

Speed Conversion

To convert speed from **km/h to m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert from **m/s to km/h**, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: The sum of the age of a father and the age of a son is 75 years. If the product of their ages before 5 years was 750, then what is the present age of the father?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of ages 5 years ago = 75 − (5 × 2) = 65 years.

Product of ages 5 years ago = 750.

Find two factors of 750 that sum to 65: 50 × 15 = 750 and 50 + 15 = 65.

Father's age 5 years ago = 50 years.

Father's present age = 50 + 5 = 55 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 55.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present sum of ages = 75 years

Product of ages 5 years ago = 750

**Formula Used:**

(x − a) × (y − a) = Product; where x + y = Sum

 
•

Let Father's present age be F years.

Then, Son's present age = (75 − F) years.

5 years ago, Father's age = (F − 5) years.

5 years ago, Son's age = (75 − F − 5) = (70 − F) years.

According to the question:

⇒ (F − 5) × (70 − F) = 750

⇒ 70F − F² − 350 + 5F = 750

⇒ −F² + 75F − 350 − 750 = 0

⇒ F² − 75F + 1100 = 0

⇒ F² − 55F − 20F + 1100 = 0

⇒ F(F − 55) − 20(F − 55) = 0

⇒ (F − 55)(F − 20) = 0

⇒ F = 55 or F = 20

Since a father must be older than his son, Father's age = 55.

**∴ The correct answer is 55.**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two people remains constant throughout their lives, regardless of the time elapsed.

Average Age Property

If the average age of n people is X, then after k years, their average age will be X + k.

questions.question: A circle is formed by a wire and its area is 154. If any equilateral triangle is formed by the same length of the wire then what will be the area of the equilateral triangle?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Circle Area** 154 → **Radius (r)** = 7 cm (Standard value).

**Wire Length** = Circumference = 2 × (22/7) × 7 = **44 cm**.

**Side of Triangle (a)** = 44 ÷ 3 = 14.66 cm.

**Area** = (√3/4) × a² = (1.732/4) × (44/3)² ≈ **93.1 cm²**.

**∴ The correct answer is 93.1 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Area of Circle** = 154 cm², Shape changed from **Circle** to **Equilateral Triangle**.

**Formula Used:** Area of Circle = πr²; Circumference = 2πr; Area of Equilateral Triangle = (√3/4)a².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/677f5dca2f3c4cf7538f213f8cc004e71681aae0842203fb86aea309d75c6af0.png] 

⇒ πr² = 154

⇒ (22/7) × r² = 154

⇒ r² = (154 × 7) ÷ 22 = 49

⇒ **Radius (r)** = √49 = 7 cm

⇒ **Length of wire** = 2 × (22/7) × 7 = 44 cm

⇒ **Perimeter of Triangle** = 3 × **Side (a)** = 44 cm

⇒ a = 44/3 cm

⇒ **Area of Triangle** = (√3/4) × (44/3)²

⇒ Area = (√3/4) × (1936/9) = 484√3/9

⇒ Area ≈ (484 × 1.732) ÷ 9 ≈ 93.14 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 93.1 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Perimeter vs Area Consistency

When a wire of fixed length L is bent into different shapes, the **Circle** always encloses the maximum area, followed by a square and then an equilateral triangle.

Equilateral Triangle Properties

Height (h) of an equilateral triangle is given by h = (√3/2) × a, where a is the side. Area can also be written as h²/√3.

Circle Constants

For a circle with **radius 7**, the **circumference is 44** and the **area is 154**. These are standard ratios used frequently in competitive exams.</p

questions.question: A trader marked the price of an article so as to earn a profit of 28% on its cost price. He sold it by giving 15% discount on its marked price. What was his actual profit percentage?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **Successive Percentage** formula: Net % = x + y + (xy/100)

⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** = ₹108.8.

⇒ **Actual Profit** = SP − CP = 108.8 − 100 = ₹8.8.

⇒ **Profit Percentage** = (8.8 / 100) × 100 = 8.8%.

questions.question: The area of the triangle whose vertices are P(2, 0), Q(5, 0) and R(5, 2) is :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Observe the **coordinates** of the vertices **P(2, 0)**, **Q(5, 0)**, and **R(5, 2)**.

Points **P** and **Q** have the same y-coordinate (0), so **PQ** is a horizontal **base**: Base = 5 − 2 = 3 units.

Points **Q** and **R** have the same x-coordinate (5), so **QR** is a vertical **height**: Height = 2 − 0 = 2 units.

Since **PQ** is horizontal and **QR** is vertical, they meet at a **90°** angle at **Q**.

Area of triangle = 1/2 × Base × Height = 1/2 × 3 × 2 = 3 units².

**∴ The correct answer is 3 unit².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Vertices of the triangle are **P(2, 0)**, **Q(5, 0)**, and **R(5, 2)**.

**Formula Used:** Area of triangle = 1/2 |x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)|

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f720c7dcb6203f6749f754987bdf5887d2f74ad1e1a5d915b167974ab28c91e.png] 

Substituting values (x₁, y₁) = (2, 0), (x₂, y₂) = (5, 0), and (x₃, y₃) = (5, 2):

⇒ Area = 1/2 |2(0 − 2) + 5(2 − 0) + 5(0 − 0)|

⇒ Area = 1/2 |2(−2) + 5(2) + 5(0)|

⇒ Area = 1/2 |−4 + 10 + 0|

⇒ Area = 1/2 |6|

⇒ Area = 3 unit²

**∴ The correct answer is 3 unit².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Triangle using Coordinates

For vertices (x₁, y₁), (x₂, y₂), and (x₃, y₃), the area is 0.5 × |x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)|.

Centroid of a Triangle

The centroid G of a triangle with vertices (x₁, y₁), (x₂, y₂), and (x₃, y₃) is given by ((x₁ + x₂ + x₃)/3, (y₁ + y₂ + y₃)/3).

Distance Formula

The distance between two points (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) is √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²).</p

In a triangle ABC, AD is the bisector of ∠BAC. If AB = 12 cm, BD = 10 cm and DC = 5 cm, then what is the perimeter of the triangle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the **Internal Angle Bisector Theorem**, the ratio of sides is equal to the ratio of the segments of the base.

AB / AC = BD / DC

12 / AC = 10 / 5 ⇒ 12 / AC = 2 / 1

⇒ AC = 6 cm

**Perimeter** = AB + (BD + DC) + AC = 12 + 15 + 6 = 33 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 33 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of side **AB** = 12 cm

Length of segment **BD** = 10 cm

Length of segment **DC** = 5 cm

**AD** is the **angle bisector** of ∠BAC.

**Formula Used:**

In ΔABC, if AD is the **internal bisector** of ∠BAC, then AB / AC = BD / DC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/991399467829e951f6352e4abcb25a0e6b25ad88aac3d81f7ada9fef9d9afbd3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, calculate the length of side **BC**:

⇒ BC = BD + DC

⇒ BC = 10 + 5 = 15 cm

⇒ Applying the **Angle Bisector Theorem**:

⇒ AB / AC = BD / DC

⇒ 12 / AC = 10 / 5

⇒ 12 / AC = 2

⇒ AC = 12 / 2 = 6 cm

⇒ Now, calculate the **perimeter** of ΔABC:

⇒ Perimeter = AB + BC + AC

⇒ Perimeter = 12 + 15 + 6

⇒ Perimeter = 33 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 33 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

External Angle Bisector Theorem

The external bisector of an angle of a triangle divides the opposite side externally in the ratio of the sides containing the angle: AB / AC = BD / CD.

Length of Angle Bisector (AD)

The length of the internal bisector AD can be calculated using the formula: AD² = AB × AC − BD × DC.

Incenter Property

The point of intersection of all three internal angle bisectors is called the incenter, which is equidistant from all sides of the triangle.</p

questions.question: In quadrilateral ABCD, AB = 17 cm, BC = 8 cm, CD = 9 cm, AD = 12 cm, and AC = 15 cm. What is the area (in cm²) of the quadrilateral?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Diagonal AC divides the quadrilateral into two right-angled triangles: ΔABC and ΔADC.

In ΔABC (sides 8 cm, 15 cm, 17 cm), 8² + 15² = 17² ⇒ Area = (1/2) × 8 × 15 = 60 cm².

In ΔADC (sides 9 cm, 12 cm, 15 cm), 9² + 12² = 15² ⇒ Area = (1/2) × 9 × 12 = 54 cm².

Total Area = Area of ΔABC + Area of ΔADC = 60 + 54 = 114 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 114 cm².**

questions.question: If tan θ = (8)/(15), then the value of frac{sqrt{1-sin θ}}{sqrt{1+sin θ}}
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__
Rationalize the expression: √((1−sin θ)/(1+sin θ)) = √((1−sin θ)²/(1−sin²θ)) = (1−sin θ)/cos θ = sec θ − tan θ.

Given tan θ = 8/15 (Perpendicular/Base), so Hypotenuse = √(8² + 15²) = 17.

sec θ = Hypotenuse/Base = 17/15.

Required value = 17/15 − 8/15 = 9/15 = 3/5.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/5.**

**__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab2f6f824f0bd5d8005ab90d20983e5a0e0e8c707c6cc505286e9b20f4d98219.png] 
**Given:** tan θ = 8/15

**Formula Used:** sin θ = P/H; Hypotenuse (H) = √(P² + B²)

⇒ Let Perpendicular (P) = 8 and Base (B) = 15.

⇒ H = √(8² + 15²) = √(64 + 225) = √289 = 17.

⇒ sin θ = P/H = 8/17.

⇒ Value = √[(1 − 8/17) / (1 + 8/17)]

⇒ Value = √[(9/17) / (25/17)] = √(9/25)

⇒ Value = 3/5.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 and 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ.

Pythagorean Triplets

(8, 15, 17) is a standard triplet where 8² + 15² = 17².

Rationalization Shortcut

√((1−sin θ)/(1+sin θ)) always simplifies to sec θ − tan θ.</p
